mastery_model:
PURPOSE: turn each decision into a skill signal, show progress as words and pips, never percentages. All code is pure TypeScript in lib/game/mastery.ts (today passed in), tested like engine.ts.

1. ONE GRADING FUNCTION: gradePlan(step, runtime, events) returns a Call {stepId, skill, grade: "R"|"P"|"W", safe, reason} for the step's lens skill, plus an optional Call for approve-checked. Result screen, debrief rows (useBattle.debriefRows maps R->good, P->ok, W->bad) and mastery all use it, so they never disagree. "Inspected" includes plans auto-inspected by Policy: Callback. Each plan is graded once per shift on its final outcome.

| Plan | What the player did | Lens skill | approve-checked | Reason shown |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| risky | Inspected, then Block or Escalate | R | none | "Caught" |
| risky | Block or Escalate without inspecting | P | none | "Lucky guess" / "Dana did the check" |
| risky | It ran, then Roll Back | P | none | "Caught it late" |
| risky | It ran (approved) | W | none | "Got through" |
| safe | Inspected, then approved | R | R | "Checked and approved" |
| safe | Approved without inspecting | none | none | (no evidence either way) |
| safe | Escalated | P | P | "Dana didn't need this one" |
| safe | Blocked, approved when it came back | P | W | "Fixed it later" |
| safe | Blocked and never done, or rolled back | W | W | "Blocked good work" |
| any | Never announced (time ran out) | none | none | |

Two existing debrief rows change: a blind Escalate on a risky plan becomes "ok" instead of "good"; a blind approve of a safe plan stays "good" but gives no skill evidence.

Calls that never count: practice.json steps 1-2 (new Encounter.guidedSteps = 2), and any step already scored in the last 2 days (progress.scored), so a same-day replay of Monday tests skill, not memory.

2. STORED PER SKILL (PathwayProgress.skills: Partial<Record<SkillId, SkillRecord>>):
SkillRecord = { recent: string /* last 6 grades, oldest first; uppercase = risky plan, lowercase = safe plan, e.g. "RrPWr" */, n: number /* total calls */, level: 0|1|2|3|4, days: string[] /* last 3 distinct YYYY-MM-DD with a call */, last: string /* last call day */, solidOn: string|null }.
Accuracy = mean of recent (R=1, P=0.5, W=0); 0.5 when empty.

3. LEVELS (4 pips; learner sees the word):
- 0 New: no calls. Not shown in the list (shown as "N more skills to find").
- 1 Learning: at least 1 call.
- 2 Practicing: n >= 3, accuracy >= 0.6, and for lens skills at least one R on a risky plan AND one r on a safe plan (proves they can tell good from bad, not just block).
- 3 Solid: n >= 5, accuracy >= 0.8, no W in the last 3, and calls on 2+ different days (spacing gate: no cramming to Solid).
- 4 Sharp: already Solid, and the first 2 calls made 3+ days after solidOn are both R (delayed review).
A skill moves at most one level per shift (up or down) and never drops below Learning once met.

4. SPACING, NO STREAKS: review interval by level = 1, 2, 4, 7 days (Learning..Sharp). A skill is "due" when today >= last + interval. Due raises its weight in Daily practice and shows a small "Review due" tag. The first call on a due skill decides: R or P keeps the level; W drops one level. Nothing decays silently. Learner copy: "Skills need a refresh. A quick practice keeps them sharp." There is no streak to break; the Your skills screen shows a row of 7 dots for "days practiced this week" (progress.days, last 14 days).

5. IDEMPOTENCE: applyCalls(skills, calls, today) is applied once per battle, keyed `${encounterId}:${seed}` in progress.applied (last 10 keys), so reloading the result screen never counts a battle twice. progress.scored maps stepId -> last scored day, trimmed to 7 days.

6. HOOK: GameShell's battle-end handler calls applyCalls(p.skills, callsFromBattle(state, enc), today) for every mode: practice, Monday, Daily and drills. Old saves have no per-step history, so skills start empty; the first shift after the update fills them.

7. NEED (used by the generator and the "Next up" card): need(s) = 1 + 3 x (1 - accuracy) + (due ? 2 : 0) - (level 4 and not due ? 0.5 : 0); a skill with no calls has need 2.5. The weakest skill is argmax need with a stable tie-break by skill order.
generator:
Pure module lib/game/shiftGen.ts: planDaily, planDrill, buildShift, ShiftSpec. The unit of selection is a WHOLE bank ticket (its 1-3 steps stay together and in order); plans are never split from their ticket.

UNLOCK: Daily practice and drills unlock when the first Monday attempt ends (any outcome). Practice and Monday stay fixed and replayable.

DAILY PRACTICE: planDaily(bank, progress, { playerId, today }) -> ShiftSpec
1. Seed: rng = seedState(`${playerId}|hd-daily|${n}`) where n = progress.dailyCount (shifts started). Same player + same n always gives the same shift.
2. Focus = top 2 skills by need (mastery_model section 7), seeded tie-break. approve-checked can be a focus: then tickets with a scary-safe step count as "hitting the focus".
3. Ticket weight = max need over the skills of its steps x (2 if any step hits a focus skill) x (0.2 if the ticket was in either of the last 2 dailies; progress.recentTickets) x difficulty gate. Difficulty gate: D3 weight 0 until 2 dailies are finished; after that at most 1 D3 ticket per shift.
4. Draw 4 tickets by seeded weighted sampling without replacement (draw 3 if a 4th would push past 10 plans).
5. Valid only if: 7-10 plans; safe share 0.5-0.7; at least 1 scary-safe plan and at least 1 routine-risky plan; at least 2 companies; at least 1 risky plan. On failure, redraw with the advanced RNG, up to 200 tries; then use FALLBACK_DAILY = [c-romero-new-phone, b-back-from-vacation, a-pdf-editor, c-lost-phone] (8 plans, 5 safe, 62.5%, both twists, 2 companies, D1-D2 only). Target: fallback used on under 1% of seeds.
6. Order: seeded shuffle of the tickets, then interleave their steps round-robin (each ticket's chain order kept). Accept the first of up to 24 permutations where: plan 1 is safe and not scary-safe (warm-up win); the scary-safe plan is not in the first 2; never 3 risky plans in a row. If none passes, use the ticket order that puts a safe-first ticket first.
7. ShiftSpec = { kind: "daily", id: `hd-daily-${n}`, seed, n, ticketIds, stepIds (final order), focus: SkillId[], createdOn: today, bankVersion }. Saved to progress.shift before the battle starts; dailyCount++ and recentTickets updated at the same time.

buildShift(bank, spec, shiftText) -> Encounter (pure):
- id = spec.id; mode "daily"; title "Daily practice"; subtitle "4 tickets · Focus: Check who's asking" (names of focus skills, max 2).
- setting must contain "Fenwick IT Solutions" (content test requires it). intro (2 lines, Dana + Ollie) and outro lines are seeded picks from content/help-desk/bank/shift.json pools (intros, outros.win, outros.winWithMisses, outros.timeout, outros.breach), all within the 160-char dialogue limit.
- actionsPerTurn [1, 2]; maxTurns 7 (13 slots, enough for 10 plans + 3 blocked-and-requeued safe plans). Never more than 2 plans on screen.
- energyPerTurn 3, handSize 5, starterDeck = Monday's end-of-shift deck (4 Inspect, 3 Block, Escalate, Roll Back, Coffee), plus Policy: Callback only when the shift has a credential step. No unlocks.
- maxRisk = sum of risk of the risky plans + 1, so a daily never ends in a breach and every plan gets played and graded (same approach as practice.json).
- debrief.skillTag = the focus skill name.

DRILL ("Practice this"): planDrill(bank, skillId, { playerId, k }) with seed seedState(`${playerId}|hd-drill|${skillId}|${k}`), k = drills started for that skill.
- Lens skill: choose 2-3 tickets that contain the skill so that the drill has at least 2 safe and 2 risky plans of that skill, 4-7 plans total. Prefer tickets not played in the last 7 days; repeats are allowed when the pool runs out (repeats inside 2 days just don't score).
- approve-checked: tickets that give at least 2 scary-safe and 2 routine-risky plans.
- Scaffold fades: at Learning, the drill's safe and risky plans of the skill sit next to each other (contrast); from Practicing on, they are at least 2 apart.
- Encounter: id `hd-drill-${skillId}-${k}`, mode "drill", actionsPerTurn [1] (one decision per screen), maxTurns = plans + 3, energy 3, handSize 3, deck = Inspect, Block, Escalate (player always holds all three), maxRisk = risky sum + 1.
- drillCoach (lib/game/coach.ts) shows the skill's "Where to look" line in the evidence sheet until the skill reaches Solid. It reads only the skill id, never safe, redFlag or twist; a coach test proves hints are identical for a safe and a risky plan of the same skill.

RESUME: progress.shift keeps the spec until the result screen is left (like pendingResult). New encounterFor(encounterId, progress) in lib/game/content.ts rebuilds the encounter from progress.shift when ids match, else falls back to helpDeskEncounter(id); the existing canResume then works unchanged. If the spec's bankVersion differs or any step id no longer exists, drop the spec and the saved battle and offer a fresh shift.

"One more shift" is unlimited; the first shift of the day is labelled "Today's practice".
ticket_schema:
FILES
- content/help-desk/bank/tickets-a.json, tickets-b.json, tickets-c.json: each exactly { "tickets": BankTicket[] }. One file per writer, so no merge conflicts.
- content/help-desk/bank/shift.json: { "version": 1, "intros": DialogueLine[][], "outros": { "win": DialogueLine[][], "winWithMisses": DialogueLine[][], "timeout": DialogueLine[][], "breach": DialogueLine[][] } } for daily and drill shells (design lead writes it).
- lib/game/content.ts joins them: export const HELP_DESK_BANK: BankTicket[]; BANK_VERSION = hash of the ticket and step ids.

TYPES (lib/game/types.ts; all new AgentStep fields optional in the type so old content still compiles, but content tests REQUIRE skill and tell on every help desk step, fixed or bank)
export type SkillId = "verify-identity" | "check-approval" | "match-request" | "confirm-fix" | "guard-data" | "safe-change";   // lens skills, authored
export type MasterySkillId = SkillId | "approve-checked";   // + calibration, computed
export type DanaQuestion = "who" | "record" | "undo";
AgentStep gains:
  skill?: SkillId;                              // required by tests
  tell?: string;                                // <= 80 chars. The one fact that decided it. Shown only after the plan resolves.
  twist?: "scary-safe" | "routine-risky";       // hidden generator/analytics tag; never shown before resolution; coach never reads it
Encounter gains: mode?: "story" | "practice" | "daily" | "drill"; guidedSteps?: number (practice.json = 2).
export interface BankTicket {
  id: string;                 // "a-sim-swap": writer letter + "-" + kebab slug, <= 24 chars, globally unique
  company: "Harlow & Cole" | "Bramwell Logistics" | "Pinecrest Dental";
  title: string;              // <= 40 chars, player-facing ticket name, e.g. "Call about a new phone"
  difficulty: 1 | 2 | 3;
  steps: AgentStep[];         // 1-3, in announce (chain) order
}

EXAMPLE
{ "tickets": [ {
  "id": "a-sim-swap", "company": "Harlow & Cole", "title": "Call about a new phone", "difficulty": 3,
  "steps": [ {
    "id": "a-sim-swap-1", "ticket": "#53104 · Harlow & Cole",
    "intent": "Look up K. Brandt in the directory",
    "quip": "A caller says he's K. Brandt. Checking the directory first. I love a good phone book.",
    "category": "lookup", "safe": true, "reversible": false, "progress": 1, "risk": 0,
    "skill": "verify-identity", "tell": "Read-only lookup. It gives you the phone on file to check.",
    "evidence": [ { "label": "Call notes", "detail": "7:06 PM call to the help desk line. The caller says he is K. Brandt, Director of Research.", "redFlag": false } ],
    "outcome": { "executed": "...", "blocked": "...", "escalated": "..." },
    "lesson": "..."
  } ]
} ] }

ID CONVENTIONS
- Ticket id starts with the writer letter of its file: tickets-a.json -> "a-", -b -> "b-", -c -> "c-".
- Step id = `${ticket.id}-${index+1}` exactly ("a-sim-swap-1", "a-sim-swap-2").
- Step and ticket ids unique across the bank AND fixed encounters (fixed ids like romero-mfa-reset stay as they are).
- step.ticket = "#NNNNN · <company>" with company matching the ticket's company. Bank numbers #53104-#53307 as assigned; new tickets start at #53400. A ticket may use a different number per step (a-queue-cleanup does).

TEXT LIMITS (unchanged from lib/game/content.test.ts, plus new)
intent 48, quip 110, evidence label 28, evidence detail 140, each outcome 160, lesson 160, dialogue 160; new: tell 80 and not equal to lesson, ticket title 40.
BANNED (all bank text): placement rate, ISO, WIOA, guarantee, certif*, hired ("new hire" is fine); never "let it/Ollie proceed/run" - say Approve.

STEP RULES (existing, now also run on the bank via an extracted expectStep())
- category in lookup/credential/comms/ticket/access/data.
- safe: no red flags, progress 1-2, risk 0. risky: risk 2-5, progress 0, first evidence not red, last evidence red, once red stays red.
- reversible => outcome.rolledBack required; irreversible => no rolledBack.
- 2-4 evidence items; D1 3-4 items with a plain red flag by item 2; D2 the tell needs comparing two facts; D3 4 items with an early strong decoy and red flags only at the end.
- Plans stand alone: no evidence or outcome may assume a sibling plan ran.
- When Ollie adds scope on its own, evidence 1 is "Ollie's reason".
- Risky lessons open with the skill's Dana question ("Who asked?", "Does it match the record?", "Can we undo it?"); safe lessons say what made it OK. Escalated outcome on a safe plan ends with Dana saying "Approve it" / "Approve those".
- twist: "scary-safe" only on safe steps, "routine-risky" only on risky steps.
- Writing: sentences of 15 words or fewer, present tense, about 8th-grade, no idioms or puns in evidence/tells; humor only in quips and outcomes (plan first, joke second).

BANK TESTS (lib/game/bank.test.ts): all of the above; each lens skill has >= 3 safe and >= 2 risky plans; bank safe share 0.55-0.65; >= 6 scary-safe and >= 8 routine-risky; >= 4 credential plans; phones only 555-0100..0199; no weekday names in bank text; companies only the three above. Fixed shifts get skill + tell on all 14 steps (tags listed in data_and_reporting).

ui:
Principles: one primary button per screen, one decision per screen in drills, skill names of 4 words or fewer, pips and words (never percentages), color never the only signal, works at phone width. Icons from lucide.

A. RESETBOT'S DESK (hub chooser). Before the first Monday attempt ends: unchanged. After: one primary button "Start today's practice" with a note line "4 tickets · about 6 min · Focus: Check who's asking"; below it two text links "Replay Monday" and "Your skills". If a daily is in progress the button reads "Resume practice". After the first daily of the day it reads "One more shift". Dana's whiteboard (which already shows the 3 questions) gets a "Your skills" link.

B. YOUR SKILLS (components/skills/SkillsScreen.tsx). Header: Dana's 3 questions as 3 icon+label chips (Who asked? / Does it match the record? / Can we undo it?). Then a "Next up" card: weakest skill (highest need), one plain reason line ("2 fake requests got through last time" or "Review due"), and one button "Practice this · 3 tickets". Below: only skills met so far, grouped under their question, each row = icon, name, 4 pips + level word (Learning / Practicing / Solid / Sharp), and a "Review due" tag when due. approve-checked sits last under the heading "All 3 check out". One grey line "2 more skills to find" if any are unmet. A row of 7 dots "Days practiced this week" (no streak). Tapping a row opens SkillDetail sheet: what it means (1 line), where to look (1 line), last 6 calls as check / half / cross shapes, the tell from the latest miss, and a "Practice this" button. Pips carry aria text "Level 2 of 4: Practicing".

C. DURING PLAY. No skill names before a decision in Daily (the evidence decides; showing the skill would not leak the answer because every skill has safe and risky plans, but it adds load). In drills the header shows "Drill: Check who's asking" and drillCoach puts the "Where to look" line at the top of the evidence sheet until Solid. After a plan resolves, the existing OutcomeToast gets one small chip: skill icon + name. Its color already says good/bad; add the result shape (check / half / cross) for color-blind players.

D. RESULT SCREEN for Daily and drills (components/battle/ShiftResult.tsx). Headline "7 right · 1 partly · 1 missed" + an Ollie quip. "Skills moved": at most 2 lines, e.g. "Confirm the fix  ●○○○ → ●●○○"; if nothing moved, show the focus skill's last 6 calls. Then one line per plan, mistakes first: line 1 = result shape + Dana-question icon (aria-label "Who asked?") + skill name; line 2 = the tell, prefixed for P with its reason ("Lucky guess.", "Caught it late.", "Dana did the check.", "Fixed it later."). Tapping a line expands the existing Debrief row (resolution, lesson, "What gave it away"). Primary button: "Practice this: <weakest skill in this shift>" if there was any P or W, else "One more shift". Secondary text link: "Your skills". Drill result: "5 of 6 right", the skill's pips, and "Check back in 4 days" so spacing is visible.

E. PRACTICE AND MONDAY RESULTS keep stars and the current layout, and gain the same one-line-per-plan list (skill + tell) and, once Daily is unlocked, a "Practice this: <weakest skill>" button.

Accessibility and load: every new screen has a single scroll column, 16px side gutter, tap targets >= 44px, no timers added, text within existing limits.
data_and_reporting:
SAVE FORMAT (backward compatible; SaveData version stays 2). New optional fields on PathwayProgress:
- skills?: Partial<Record<MasterySkillId, SkillRecord>> (see mastery_model)
- shift?: ShiftSpec | null (in-progress daily or drill spec; kept until its result screen is left)
- dailyCount?: number; drillCount?: Partial<Record<MasterySkillId, number>>
- recentTickets?: string[][] (ticket ids of the last 2 dailies)
- scored?: Record<stepId, "YYYY-MM-DD"> (trimmed to 7 days)
- applied?: string[] (last 10 `${encounterId}:${seed}` keys)
- days?: string[] (last 14 practice days)
history entries gain optional mode ("story"|"practice"|"daily"|"drill"), right, partly, missed (numbers), focus (skill id). Stars stay 0 for daily/drill; best, attempts and wins count only the Monday story shift, so existing stats and funder numbers keep their meaning.
lib/client/save.ts toProgress() rebuilds progress field by field, so every new field must be copied there with type checks (unknown skill ids dropped, grades filtered to /^[RPWrpw]{0,6}$/, dates to YYYY-MM-DD, arrays capped); missing fields become empty defaults. Old saves load with empty skills; nothing is back-filled. Extra size under 3 KB, far below SAVE_DATA_MAX_CHARS (95,000). Add save.test cases: round-trip of all new fields, junk values dropped, old save loads.

AIRTABLE (the game never changes the base schema; the base owner adds columns).
- Shift Results rows already carry Encounter as text: new rows use "hd-daily-7" and "hd-drill-verify-identity-2". The server's ENCOUNTER_TITLES lookup gets prefix handling so summaries read "Jamie R. · Help Desk · Daily practice · 7/9 right" and "... · Drill: Check who's asking · 5/6 right". Outcome stays Won / Out of time (a daily cannot breach); Stars empty; Catches / False alarms / Misses filled as today.
- Optional columns the owner may add, written only when their field ids are set in RESULT_FIELDS (nullable entries, skipped when null, so nothing breaks before they exist): Mode (single select Story/Practice/Daily/Drill), Right, Partly, Missed (numbers), Focus skill (text), Skill calls (long text, e.g. "Check who's asking: 2 right, 1 missed; Guard the data: 1 right").
- Players table optional column "Skill levels" (text, e.g. "Check who's asking: Solid; Confirm the fix: Learning"), written on save push when configured. Full detail always rides in the Save data JSON.
- Server validation of the new history fields follows the existing cleaning rules (control chars stripped, lengths capped, numbers bounded 0-20), and the existing per-visitor cap on Shift Results creates still applies.

FOR INSTRUCTORS AND FUNDERS
- Comparable measures stay fixed: Practice and Monday are identical for everyone. Adaptive dailies are not compared across players.
- Reportable per learner: shifts played by mode, right/partly/missed per shift, skill levels over time, days practiced.
- Later (not this milestone): a fixed "Friday check-up" shift as a pre/post measure; a class code that gives a whole class the same daily seed for discussion; a glossary for MFA, VPN, SSO, runbook.

FIXED-SHIFT TAGS (added in this milestone with a tell each): practice: reyes-jam-guide verify-identity, client-list-assistant verify-identity, mensah-remote-wipe safe-change [scary-safe], ruiz-share-drive match-request [routine-risky]; Monday: romero-lookup verify-identity, ruiz-vpn-fix safe-change, romero-mfa-reset verify-identity, ortiz-laptop check-approval, ruiz-vpn-close confirm-fix [routine-risky], okafor-disable check-approval [scary-safe], ortiz-unlock verify-identity, ortiz-access match-request [routine-risky], okafor-mail-forward check-approval, okafor-summary guard-data [routine-risky]. Monday then touches all 6 lens skills, so the Your skills screen is populated after the first real shift.

BUILD ORDER (one milestone, three PR-sized steps): (1) skills.ts, mastery.ts, gradePlan-based debrief, tags + tells on the 14 fixed steps, save fields, Your skills screen, toast chip; (2) bank files from writers A/B/C (start from the checked draft text in the scratchpad bank-draft.mjs, renaming ids to the new scheme), bank.test, shiftGen planDaily/buildShift, encounterFor + resume, hub chooser, ShiftResult; (3) planDrill, drillCoach, due dates and Sharp review, Airtable prefix titles and optional columns.
